Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1287.jpg'}
{1: 'Inside the City of Xoth', 2: 'Atlantic Ocean, Earth'}
{2: 'Atlantic Ocean, Earth\\nInside the City of Xoth'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiRpgTowerMain3d/FxUiRpgTowerMain3d01.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Question—who in this world knows the most secrets?', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Answer—the moon.'}
{1: 'She sees through every door and window, every graveyard, every darkened night. She sees evil masquerading as justice, and madness carried out with calmness.'}

{1: 'The moon over Xoth is being merciful tonight. A rotting mermaid leans against the pool and sings, while a wife wheels her beloved to the windowsill. A fairy hides behind a mirror, revealing visions of a fishing village.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Another pair of drowners has been delivered to the shore by Patches. Another cycle begins anew.', 7: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory896.jpg', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiRpgTowerMain3d/FxUiRpgTowerMain3d01.prefab'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wife', 3: 'The Songstress Trials are about to begin again. Do you think they will succeed?', 4: '1', 18: '100019666'}
{1: '1', 3: "She rests her hand on her husband's shoulder. He is strapped to a wheelchair, his expression vacant, if not catatonic."}
{3: "He doesn't respond to his wife. Instead, he keeps tapping the black and white keys with two fingers, composing. This is one of the few things that still makes him feel alive."}
{3: "Without saying a word, the wife produces a razor. Only when he sees that delicate instrument of pain does the man's expression shift to one of fear."}
{2: 'Composer', 3: "No! Don't take that out!", 4: '1', 18: '100019667'}
{2: 'Composer', 3: "Don't put it in my head! Stop editing my memories!", 4: '1', 18: '100019668'}
{3: "She ignores her beloved's wails and softly hums a lullaby as she operates."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wife', 3: 'Relax, my hands are steady. I was an excellent surgeon out there, after all.', 4: '1', 18: '100019669'}
{2: 'Wife', 3: "Something wrong has grown inside your mind... You want to leave me! If I don't treat it now, we can't be happy together, can we?", 4: '1', 18: '100019670'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Composer', 3: "I won't! I swear I'll stay! I'll stay here with you quietly, until the end of time.", 4: '1', 18: '100019671'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wife', 3: "No, you're lying. We've been together for over 30 years now. It's long enough for me to know when you're telling the truth.", 4: '1', 18: '100019672'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Composer', 3: "It's not a lie! Please, believe me! Won't you believe me just this once?", 4: '1', 18: '100019673'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront17.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{3: 'Her husband falls silent soon enough. Not because the anesthesia has kicked in, but because his vocal module has been severed.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront17.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Or rather, there was never any anesthesia to begin with. Sometimes, hatred is the finest surgical tool. It is sharp enough to turn anyone into a devil.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory391.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'The ancient creature lurking in the deep stirs, as if sensing this intense emotion. In its deathlike slumber, it exhales a slow breath of crimson mist.'}
{3: 'It is an impossible creature that defies all rules of biology. Even attempting to describe it is an affront to the human mind.'}
{3: "If some people had yet to lose their minds to the city's illusions, they would understand the true nature of that crimson mist... the Punishing Virus."}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1008.jpg', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab'}
{1: 'Nameless Fishing Village, Xoth', 2: 'Atlantic Ocean, Earth'}
{2: 'Atlantic Ocean, Earth\\nNameless Fishing Village, Xoth'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{3: 'The aroma of fish broth awakens you.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgCg/Cg3801_10.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFireLiziNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: 'You force your eyes open to find a campfire, a pot, and Karenina before you.'}
{3: 'She is using some tin cylinder she scrounged up to blow air into the flame. With every puff, at least half the ash and embers come flying right back at her.'}
{3: 'But she just wipes her face without a care and keeps battling the campfire until she is covered in soot like a feral cat.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryFireLiziNew.prefab'}
{3: 'She jumps up with delight at the sound of your voice, abandoning whatever she was working on to rush over and help you sit up.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "See? I knew a little scratch like that wouldn't keep you down.", 4: '1', 18: '100019674'}
{2: 'Did you prepare all this?', 3: '85'}
{3: 'You are lying on a bed woven from banana leaves. Before you stands a makeshift shelter cobbled together from driftwood, and Karenina is passing you a bowl of fish soup in a coconut shell.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hmph, pretty much. We had it way harder than this when I was living with Grandpa in the conservation area.', 4: '1', 18: '100019685'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "We'd scavenge scraps and make do when times got rough, but we always managed to get by if we just patched things up here and there.", 4: '1', 18: '100019696'}
{3: 'You get the feeling that Karenina could thrive even if she were stranded on a deserted island by herself.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Go ahead, try the soup. I threw it together while you were out, so don't expect anything fancy. But hey, it shouldn't taste too bad!", 4: '1', 18: '100019698'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I mean, it's been ages since I've cooked anything. Back when I was a kid, my idea of cooking a meal was tossing some hardtacks into boiling water and giving it a stir.", 4: '1', 18: '100019699'}
{2: 'This smells delicious.', 3: '98'}
{3: 'Not wanting to let her down, you lift the coconut shell and prepare to drink it in one go.'}
{3: 'Karenina looks at you eagerly. Despite how casual she sounds, she is clearly looking forward to hearing what you think.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest.prefab'}
{3: "The moment that spicy, bitter concoction hits your tongue, you gain an experience you will not forget soon. Calling it a witch's brew would be generous."}
{2: "It's so spicy and bitter and sour.", 3: '108'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "What's wrong? Does it taste off?! That can't be right... Could there be something wrong with the local fish?", 4: '1', 18: '100019700'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Or maybe the lemon and herbs I used to get rid of the fishy smell weren't right? Otherwise, where else could I have messed up?", 4: '1', 18: '100019701'}
{3: 'Karenina peers into the pot as she stirs, and her movements gradually slow, her head drooping like a wilting plant.'}
{3: 'Looks like she found the culprit.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "So, uh... I forgot to take out the guts, Commandant... I'm a bit... I mean, I'm very... uh... sorry.", 4: '1', 18: '100019702'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Sure, it's not like I get many chances to work with fresh ingredients, but still... I shouldn't have...", 4: '1', 18: '100019703'}
{2: "It's okay.", 3: '124', 4: 'It was quite unique, actually.', 5: '127'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "H-how could it possibly be okay...?! I know you're just saying that to make me feel better! I'm not some single-celled idiot!", 4: '1', 18: '100019704'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Anyway, I definitely won't forget it next time!", 4: '1', 18: '100019705'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Really? You really think so?', 4: '1', 18: '100019706'}
{3: "Karenina's face lights up once more."}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Anyway, this was just a technical trial... Next time, I'll show you what I'm really capable of!", 4: '1', 18: '100019707'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory912.jpg'}
{3: 'Karenina scrambles to clean up the mess. At least there are some fish you can grill.'}
{3: 'The hot food chases away the exhaustion and cold. No matter the circumstances, a full stomach has a way of making life feel hopeful again.'}
{3: 'Only those who experience such moments regularly can live a happy, fulfilled life.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "You're looking way better. Let's get moving once you've rested up!", 4: '1', 18: '100019708'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I asked around earlier, and that building over there is the Wanderers' Lodge. It's where they take in outsiders like us.", 4: '1', 18: '100019709'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I wonder if Kiki's there... She should be fine on her own, right?", 4: '1', 18: '100019710'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "What if she's starving? Or sleeping on the streets? What if the locals are giving her trouble... No, there's no way.", 4: '1', 18: '100019711'}
{2: "You're really worried about Kiki, aren't you?", 3: '146'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Of course I'm worried. But instead of the fact that she ran here... I'm more worried about what made her desperate enough to do it in the first place.", 4: '1', 18: '100019712'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "This place is real creepy, right? No one in their right mind would come here. But she'd rather hide out in a place like this than stay with the Engineering Force.", 4: '1', 18: '100019713'}
{3: "You don't know what to say to comfort Karenina at the moment. After putting out the campfire, the two of you carefully erase any trace of your presence on the shore."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory912.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}

{3: 'You gaze toward the distant city, where grand structures stand. Castle ruins scatter across the landscape, towers and stone steps wind together like a maze, and ghostly flames flicker among the shadowy woods.'}
{2: 'To think they built a city like this beneath the sea...', 3: '158'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory912.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Oh, I forgot to tell you that Xoth is actually a projection city. In reality, this whole place is probably just a bunch of white rooms.', 4: '1', 18: '100019714'}
{3: 'You look carefully and find no projection device on you or anywhere nearby. And yet, everything you see feels so real.'}
{3: 'The silver moonlight ripples across the water as mist drifts by, while insects cast jagged-edged shadows on leaves. Even senses of touch and smell accompany the illusion.'}
{2: "Everything I'm seeing is fake?", 3: '167'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hey, let me finish first. This place actually uses state-of-the-art retinal projection technology. The projection works directly on your neural network.', 4: '1', 18: '100019715'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "That's why there's no need for any devices. The moment we entered the base, we stepped into the projection.", 4: '1', 18: '100019716'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Sure, it's generated by underwater computers, but it's pulling from a massive database of real-world samples. That's what makes it this convincing.", 4: '1', 18: '100019717'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'In theory, the more people who enter, the bigger the sample pool gets, and the more realistic the environment becomes.', 4: '1', 18: '100019718'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'But the experiment was shut down later on.', 4: '1', 18: '100019719'}
{2: 'Why? The technology seems so promising.', 3: '176'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Retinal projection was originally developed to improve the lives of blind people. Thanks to the neural projection, they can still "see" the projected world even if they are blind.', 4: '1', 18: '100019720'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Once the technology was developed, they recruited plenty of blind volunteers to try it out. At first, everyone was thrilled, but the volunteers couldn't go back to their old lives after experiencing sight.", 4: '1', 18: '100019721'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: "But the projection area was too limited, so it couldn't fully meet their expectations. Many couldn't handle the disparity and suffered breakdowns or worse, so they pulled the plug on the whole thing.", 4: '1', 18: '100019722'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'It started out as something good, but it ended up spiraling out of control.', 4: '1', 18: '100019723'}
{2: "It's a messy situation, that's for sure.", 3: '183'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Anyway, no point overthinking it. Let's move!", 4: '1', 18: '100019724'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1388.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1388.jpg'}
{3: 'You follow Karenina through the decaying medieval streets, and the lamplight catches her resolute and unwavering profile.'}
{3: 'She remains untouched by the bleak atmosphere, radiating warmth and vitality like the sun itself.'}
{3: 'Your elongated shadows merge and dance across the ground as you chase after her. Your swift stride takes on the rhythm of a waltz.'}
{3: 'Suddenly, Karenina comes to a halt and points at the complex before you.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Yeah, this should be it. We're here, Commandant.", 4: '1', 18: '100019725'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Before you can push the door open, someone comes flying out, tumbling down the steps and landing in an undignified heap at your feet.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A handful of oddly dressed clergy file out afterward, wielding long-handled scythes in relentless pursuit.'}
{2: 'Choir Member A', 3: 'O great Carcosa! This outsider has twisted thy supreme will!', 4: '1', 18: '100019726'}

{2: 'Choir Member A', 3: "Report: I have confirmed that [Lord Kiki]'s residence shows no signs of Songstress candidate activity. Therefore, her registration is deemed—fraudulent... fraudulent... fraudulent.", 4: '1', 18: '100019727'}
{2: 'Choir Member B', 3: 'In an endlessly repeating nightmare, a lie remains a lie.', 4: '3', 18: '100019728'}
{2: 'Choir Member B', 3: 'Report: Fraudulent registrant [Lord Kiki] and her accomplices [Deerbear] and [Huhunina] have been apprehended.', 4: '3', 18: '100019729'}
{2: 'Choir Member C', 3: 'All who deceive shall have their sins repaid in full.', 4: '2', 18: '100019730'}

{2: 'Choir Member C', 3: 'Report: In the name of the Choir, I shall act on the will of the King in Yellow and pass judgment upon [Lord Kiki]. Determining verdict... awaiting response, awaiting response, awaiting response.', 4: '2', 18: '100019731'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Deerbear', 3: 'Lord Kiki is amazing! A-ma-zing!', 4: '1', 18: '100019732'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The floating teddy bear with a deer headpiece beats a tiny drum with each pause, its face resembling a certain vice-captain from the Engineering Force.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Huhunina', 3: 'Hu! Well done-hu, Lord-hu Kiki-hu!', 4: '1', 18: '100019733'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Fluttering on the other side is a Huhu, a native Atlantic being. It bears an uncanny resemblance to the other captain of the Engineering Force.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Stop cheering already! Why are you hyping me up at a time like this?', 4: '3', 18: '100019734'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Come on, can you artificial intelligence act a little more intelligent? At least learn to read the room!', 4: '3', 18: '100019735'}
{3: "The girl being cornered still wears her lab coat. Dodging the clerics' attacks, she grabs her pets, one in each hand."}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'All of you, shut it! You stupid AIs!', 4: '3', 18: '100019736'}
{1: 'PanelActor3Shake'}
{3: 'The girl, finally at her breaking point, stands with her back to the group and cries out with her arms raised, before suddenly getting kicked from behind.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'By Karenina.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Looks like our search is over. I found her!', 4: '1', 18: '100019737'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'You came, Boss! You actually came!', 4: '1', 18: '100019739'}
{3: 'Still sprawling on the ground, the intern cries out in excitement before she even gets up. But then her expression shifts, having realized something.'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: '...Hey, Choir? Maybe you should take me in after all.', 4: '1', 18: '100019741'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "If I go back now, my punishment would be the least of my worries. I'd never hear the end of it for the rest of my life.", 4: '1', 18: '100019742'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Choir Member A', 3: 'Hold. A new variable has appeared. Potential Songstress candidate detected. Requesting secondary confirmation.', 4: '1', 18: '100019743'}
{2: 'Choir Member B', 3: 'Executing secondary confirmation. Initiating scan.', 4: '2', 18: '100019744'}
{3: "Xoth's acolytes may look human on the outside, but their minds and movements are no different from those of machines."}
{1: '1', 3: 'Without a word, they size Karenina up from head to toe.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hey! Did I say you could scan me?! What happened to basic manners?', 4: '1', 18: '100019745'}
{1: '1', 3: "Unwilling to waste any more time on these people, Karenina moves to pull Kiki away and leave. That's when the chorus members draw their blades in unison, pointing them at you all."}
{2: 'Choir Member A', 3: 'Only the victorious Songstress may decide the fate of their wandering kin. You do not have clearance!', 4: '1', 18: '100019746'}
{3: 'At that proclamation, all surrounding residents freeze mid-motion before turning toward you in unison, each bearing the same empty, soulless eyes.'}
{1: 'PanelActor1Shake'}
{1: '1', 3: 'A massive, hairy hand appears from above, two of its fingers pinching together to pluck Kiki up with perfect precision and suspend her in midair.'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: "No! Don't let the creepy hand take me away—ahhh!", 4: '1', 18: '100019747'}
{1: 'PanelActor1Shake', 6: '1'}
{3: 'Caught in midair, Kiki flails about like a crab. But the more she struggles, the tighter the hand grips her.'}
{3: 'Karenina and you raise your weapons, standing back-to-back beneath Kiki. It has become so quiet that you can hear dogs barking in the distance.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Don't be scared. I got you.", 4: '1', 18: '100019749'}
{3: "Karenina swings her weapon as she scans the area for the weakest point in their defenses. You are glad that she hasn't resorted to using her explosives immediately."}
{2: "Hold on. Don't strike yet.", 3: '310'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Why? Kiki\'s still in their "clutches," and these guys don\'t look all that tough anyway.', 4: '1', 18: '100019750'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "If we strike now, we'll probably take them down in no time!", 4: '1', 18: '100019751'}
{2: 'But they outnumber us.', 3: '314'}
{2: 'The residents might attack us all at once if we make a move.', 3: '315'}
{2: "Let's find out what they want before deciding our next move.", 3: '317'}
{3: 'After considering the drawn-out brawl you would be in for, Karenina grudgingly decides to follow your lead despite not being happy about it.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Alright, spill it. What's this Songstress thing about?", 4: '1', 18: '100019752'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Choir Member B', 3: 'The Songstress Trial is a festival led by the Choir, an organization devoted to serving the Great One.', 4: '3', 18: '100019753'}
{2: 'Choir Member C', 3: 'We select a Songstress who possesses the Song of True Love within the city and offer her song to the slumbering Great One.', 4: '2', 18: '100019754'}
{2: 'Choir Member A', 3: 'When the Great One awakens, the ship beneath the sea shall set sail and begin the journey to Xoth in space.', 4: '1', 18: '100019755'}
{2: "What if the Songstress fails and doesn't wake the Great One?", 3: '329'}
{2: 'Choir Members A, B, & C', 3: 'Then... we... continue... searching... for... a new... Songstress.', 4: '1', 5: '2', 6: '3', 18: '100019756'}
{2: 'Choir Members A, B, & C', 3: 'An endless... offering... for the Great One.', 4: '1', 5: '2', 6: '3', 18: '100019757'}
{3: 'The Choir answers without hesitation, their tone and cadence reminiscent of customer service AIs, except they are laced with an unwavering fanaticism.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'You move closer to Karenina and lower your voice.'}
{2: 'If I\'m right, this has to be Xoth\'s "script."', 3: '339'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "Seriously, what kind of messed-up script is this?! We've got way too much on our plate already. I'm not wasting time on some stupid roleplay!", 4: '1', 18: '100019758'}
{3: 'Karenina sounds more resigned than angry. Glancing around, she notices that all eyes are still on your group.'}
{3: 'The people here might all be dressed like medieval townsfolk, but there must be more than just mechanoids wandering around beyond the projection.'}
{3: 'A good portion of them are probably humans or Constructs like Kiki who stumbled in here by accident. Starting a fight now will definitely put innocent people at risk.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'With that thought, Karenina takes a deep breath and puffs out her cheeks, forcing herself to look more agreeable and follow the script reluctantly.'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "So, what happens to her if she doesn't participate?", 4: '1', 18: '100019759'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Choir Member A', 3: "Report: sentencing results decreed. Based on the perpetrator's age, motive, and criminal history, and comparing cases from the past 18 months...", 4: '1', 18: '100019760'}

{2: 'Choir Member A', 3: 'The suspect is hereby sentenced to 13 months of community service in the Goblet Dungeon. During this duration, her voting rights will be revoked, and she must wear the Silencing Chains.', 4: '1', 18: '100019761'}
{2: 'Choir Member A', 3: 'Does the suspect acknowledge the verdict?', 4: '1', 18: '100019762'}
{2: 'Choir Member B', 3: 'If there are no objections, your detention will begin immediately. Your sentence will commence at once.', 4: '3', 18: '100019763'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: "No, please! My evaluation exam is coming up! If I miss it, I'll have to wait another six months of job rotations before I can retake it!", 4: '1', 18: '100019764'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Don't worry about the exam right now, Kiki. Did you sign up for that Songstress competition?", 4: '1', 18: '100019765'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: 'Yeah... It was the only way I could have a place to stay and food to eat.', 4: '1', 18: '100019766'}
{2: 'Kiki', 3: 'I happened to have a recording of your performance on hand, so I went ahead and submitted it, but I never thought things would... turn out like this!', 4: '1', 18: '100019767'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Choir Member B', 3: 'Indeed. She also redeemed her Dream Privilege and this pair of pet companions.', 4: '1', 18: '100019768'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kiki', 3: "I-I didn't mean to redeem them! It's just... they came with the bundle, so I... Okay, okay, that one's my fault.", 4: '1', 18: '100019769'}
{3: "Guilt creeps into Kiki's voice, and it gradually drops to barely a whisper."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Kiki's not going anywhere with you people. This whole thing is a misunderstanding. She never signed up for any competition.", 4: '1', 18: '100019770'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "I'll straighten this out with your supervisor, but first, you let her down right now!", 4: '1', 18: '100019771'}
{2: 'Karenina', 3: "She's my intern, not some criminal!", 4: '1', 18: '100019772'}

{3: "Faced with Karenina's unwavering conviction, the clergy members exchange uncertain glances before reporting the situation to their superiors. Fortunately, things take a turn for the better after a tense standoff."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Choir Member C', 3: 'The Administrator has approved your request. Please proceed to the headquarters immediately.', 4: '1', 18: '100019773'}
{1: '1', 3: 'With the approval granted, the giant hand releases Kiki, who immediately hides behind Karenina and refuses to come out.'}
{3: "Karenina awkwardly tries to comfort Kiki, raising her hand to Kiki's shoulder, lowering it, then raising it again, before letting it drop gently once more."}
{3: 'The world returns to normal, and people go back to their own business, no longer staring at you all. It is as if the eerie silence and those watching eyes had been nothing but an illusion.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "You can sniffle for a bit, but save the rest for when I get back. It's no big deal, really, so don't worry. I'll make sure you get home safe and sound.", 4: '15', 18: '100019774'}

{1: '1', 3: 'She then points to the deer-headed teddy bear and the Huhu with a flower wreath. They are both fluttering cheerfully in the air, and it is hard not to draw certain conclusions from their appearances.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "And you better explain what the deal is with those two when I'm back.", 4: '18', 18: '100019775'}

{1: '1', 3: 'The carriage to the Chorus headquarters is very cramped, as the space meant for two at most is now packed with four people. Kiki, meanwhile, has been taken to a separate carriage under guard.'}
{3: 'To avoid any unnecessary chatter, Karenina crosses her arms the moment she boards, only staring out the window or down at her knees, and occasionally letting out a dismissive huff or two.'}
{3: 'With her nose flushed from the stuffy air, Karenina looks even more adorable than usual. Without Kiki around, she finally drops her tough-boss act.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Disable'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The road blocks up at a corner, and a group of children carrying baskets rushes toward you. The one in front grabs onto the carriage window, practically shoving half her body inside.'}
{3: "If anyone in the carriage took a closer look, they would notice a mermaid in the urchin's reflection in the puddles instead."}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: 'Please, buy some flowers! Or how about scorched-tail butterflies? There are still plenty of lingering Spirituality in them!', 4: '1', 18: '100019776'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: "I've also got minerals, firstborn baby teeth, rat eyes... so take a look! These are all quality goods!", 4: '1', 18: '100019777'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: 'Hey! What the hell are you doing?! Why are you treating your own people like this?', 4: '1', 18: '100019779'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V470hailuoNormal01.png'}
{3: "Having stopped the Chorus members from chasing off the children, Karenina glances into the urchin's basket. The only thing that looks remotely normal is a glowing conch seashell."}
{3: 'The child deftly produces it for display. Warm light radiates from within the seashell, shimmering brilliantly through the misty rain.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Urchin', 3: 'What excellent taste you have, madam! This is a highly valuable magical seashell. Once wielded by the King in Yellow himself, it was stolen and smuggled out by a witch for resale.', 4: '1', 18: '100019780'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: 'It can produce a luck spell with a 100% success rate, but it can only be used once, sadly.', 4: '1', 18: '100019781'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: "Why don't you offer it to this madam as a gift? She seems quite taken with it.", 4: '1', 18: '100019782'}
{2: "I don't have any local currency.", 3: '450'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Karenina', 3: "Hmph, I was just looking. I didn't like it that much.", 4: '1', 18: '100019783'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Urchin', 3: "No worries. Why don't we see what you've got on you? I'm not opposed to a little bartering.", 4: '1', 18: '100019784'}
{3: 'Confident that she can close the deal, the urchin pushes the sale even harder.'}
{2: '(Check your pockets)', 3: '459'}
{3: 'After rummaging through your pockets, you only find a handful of vanilla candies that you grabbed before leaving and a soggy ballpoint pen.'}
{2: "Yeah, there's really nothing worth trading here.", 3: '465'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Urchin', 3: "The vanilla candies are great. They'll grow into a whole field of vanilla flowers next year if I plant them now.", 4: '1', 18: '100019675'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: "The pen's great too. I can use it to write poetry and draw pictures.", 4: '1', 18: '100019676'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: "Deal. I'll take them all.", 4: '1', 18: '100019677'}
{3: 'The child snatches the items from your hands before you can even hesitate. During the exchange, you can feel something flows out of your body, while something else flows in.'}
{3: 'The disorientation you are feeling is distinct yet indescribable. All you know is that something intangible has been altered in the subtlest of ways.'}

{2: 'Karenina', 3: 'You can find these things everywhere outside! And the whole magic thing is obviously a scam!', 4: '1', 18: '100019679'}

{2: 'Choir Member B', 3: 'Junk for junk. A fair trade.', 4: '2', 18: '100019681'}
{1: '1', 3: "The cynical observation does nothing to dampen Karenina's joy. She cradles the seashell in her palm, studying it intently before slipping it into her pocket."}

{1: '1', 3: 'Meanwhile, the "urchin" watches the group enter the estate in a shadowy alley nearby, her form rippling and shifting. She makes a covert transmission.'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: '"Captain Rolmo", your item has been delivered.', 4: '1', 18: '100019686'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: "To be honest, I don't really get it... We're in the deep sea, so why would you have me pose as a human instead of a mermaid?", 4: '1', 18: '100019687'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '11', 4: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: 'The essence of a performance lies in playing a character, not yourself.', 4: '11', 18: '100019688'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: 'If you want them to clear the script successfully, why have me extract their "Sanity" and give them "Luck" instead?', 4: '1', 18: '100019689'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: 'Why not just shut down the projection and let them duke it out with Carcosa directly?', 4: '1', 18: '100019690'}
{2: 'Urchin', 3: "Defeating something like that while protecting everyone else shouldn't be a problem for the commandant.", 4: '1', 18: '100019691'}

{2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: 'That would take away so much of the fun. The fun of watching them struggle, confront unavoidable problems, be deterred by the narrative... All kinds of fun.', 4: '11', 18: '100019692'}

{2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: 'We extracted their "Spirituality" to keep them from getting too immersed in the script, so that they can glimpse the truth. And we gave them "Luck" to ensure they have a better shot in the upcoming fight.', 4: '11', 18: '100019693'}
{2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: 'Key items are meant to be used at key moments. Besides, it would be such a waste if no one got to experience a stage this magnificent.', 4: '11', 18: '100019694'}
{2: '"Captain Rolmo"', 3: "That's enough questions for today, Lamia. Keep observing and doing what you do best.", 4: '11', 18: '100019697'}
